title: The metallicity-archive census — the method, before any measurement

cards.heading: The metallicity-archive census — the method, before any measurement
cards.body: The question: which of the archive's tables could even support a mass–metallicity relation? This cut shows only how that census was built. The result is deliberately not in this video. NebulaMind Lab.

cards.heading: No result is authorized — this cut shows only the method
cards.display_citation: NebulaMind census workflow checklist · frozen record
cards.body: This lane has no source-and-status freeze, so no measurement may be stated. The eligibility rules exist and are frozen, but they have not yet been applied — no eligible-table count exists to report. What can be shown is how the census was built.

cards.heading: The eligibility rules were frozen before they touched a table
cards.body: The eligibility contract was frozen on Duho's instruction before being applied to any candidate. A census that decides its rules after seeing the tables could steer its own outcome; this one cannot.

cards.display_citation: NebulaMind MZR archive census · frozen T1 run · 2026-08-05
cards.body: single-table candidates recorded by the frozen census — tables where all three quantities are reachable together.

cards.heading: Three search axes, one intersection — the spine is arithmetic, not judgment
cards.body: Each axis is searched separately; a candidate must be reachable on all three in the same table. 178 tables intersect; 21 drop when error-modifier columns empty an axis — 19 on redshift and the rest on abundance — leaving 157 recorded candidates.

cards.heading: One table must carry all three — joins are not assessed
cards.display_citation: NebulaMind MZR archive census · frozen T1 run · 2026-08-05
cards.body: The frozen rule: a candidate is a single table where abundance, mass, and redshift are each metadata-reachable. Cross-table joins and crossmatches are not assessed, and nothing here claims a table's values are adjudicated measurements.

cards.heading: The search was tested before it was trusted
cards.display_citation: NebulaMind MZR archive census · frozen T1 run · 2026-08-05
cards.body: Seven known member tables were planted, and all seven were returned; three decoy controls were planted, and none appeared. That certifies retrieval, not precision — the recorded misses split into symbol collisions and target-domain mismatches, and none of those examples is an eligibility ruling.

cards.heading: A vocabulary scan is a side check, not evidence
cards.display_citation: NebulaMind T1E gas-phase vocabulary scan · frozen pattern
cards.body: 62 of the 157 recorded descriptions match a frozen gas-phase term pattern. That is vocabulary presence only — an internal side check. The frozen eligibility rules still apply to all 157 candidates; none has been ruled in or out.

cards.heading: Why there is no measurement in this video
cards.display_citation: NebulaMind census workflow checklist · frozen record
cards.body: Open gates: the eligibility contract is frozen but its application is not completed, so no eligible-table count exists; the census reads archive metadata, not adjudicated measurements; and no lane freeze authorizes any result. Until those close, this lane states what could be measured — not what was.

cards.heading: nebulamind.net
cards.body: A census of what could be measured. The measuring ships only after its gates close.
